rv.q: But what Page's production brings out beautifully is the tortured love under the endless chain of accusation and counter-accusation.
It is an immensely sad and touching performance which keeps this most personal and tragic of great American plays, as it is throughout, on just the right side of a debilitating pathos.
Tender though Page's considered and considerable production is, you long for something more raw.

cn.t: Metcalf's commanding performance anchors this trimmed revival, though critics are divided on whether the shortened running time sacrifices O'Neill's essential power, with Suchet's nuanced work earning praise despite some concerns.
